key.name: thumbnail-scale
key.description: Multiplies GNOME's maximum thumbnail size (5% of the screen). 1.0 is GNOME's default size. With many workspaces the thumbnails can be held back by the screen width instead.

key.name: drag-whole-thumbnail
key.summary: Reorder by dragging the whole thumbnail
key.description: Drag a thumbnail from anywhere on it to move its workspace, instead of by the grip on its top edge. Windows can then no longer be dragged out of the thumbnails.

key.name: debug-stats
key.summary: Log debug statistics (hidden, not in prefs)
